column3: Close to the Hebrew; “it continually prostitutes itself from after Yahweh” is rendered “the land has committed great harlotry By departing from the LORD.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will visit the bloodshed” is rendered “I will avenge the bloodshed.”
NKJV supplies “God” as the speaker and renders “for I will surely forgive (lift up) them” as “But I will utterly take them away.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “God” as the speaker and renders “I will not be [I AM] to you” as “I will not be your God.”
MT 2:1. Close to the Hebrew; “children of the living God” is rendered “sons of the living God.”
MT 2:2. Close to the Hebrew; “one chief” is rendered “one head.”
